verses.original: וְאַתָּ֡ה הַקְרֵ֣ב אֵלֶיךָ֩ אֶת־ אַהֲרֹ֨ן אָחִ֜יךָ וְאֶת־ בָּנָ֣יו אִתּ֔וֹ מִתּ֛וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְכַהֲנוֹ־ לִ֑י אַהֲרֹ֕ן נָדָ֧ב וַאֲבִיה֛וּא אֶלְעָזָ֥ר וְאִיתָמָ֖ר בְּנֵ֥י אַהֲרֹֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh haq·rêḇ ’ê·le·ḵā ’eṯ- ’a·hă·rōn ’ā·ḥî·ḵā wə·’eṯ- bā·nāw ’it·tōw mit·tō·wḵ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl lə·ḵa·hă·nōw- lî ’a·hă·rōn nā·ḏāḇ wa·’ă·ḇî·hū ’el·‘ā·zār wə·’î·ṯā·mār bə·nê ’a·hă·rōn
verses.literal: Next have your brother Aaron brought to you from among the Israelites . . . along with his sons - Nadab Abihu Eleazar and Ithamar to serve Me as priests
verses.literalPt: DEPOIS tu farás chegar a ti teu irmão Arão, e seus filhos com ele, do meio dos filhos de Israel, para me administrarem o ofício sacerdotal; a saber: Arão, Nadabe, e Abiú, Eleazar e Itamar, os filhos de Arão.

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ בִגְדֵי־ קֹ֖דֶשׁ לְאַהֲרֹ֣ן אָחִ֑יךָ לְכָב֖וֹד וּלְתִפְאָֽרֶת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā ḇiḡ·ḏê- qō·ḏeš lə·’a·hă·rōn ’ā·ḥî·ḵā lə·ḵā·ḇō·wḏ ū·lə·ṯip̄·’ā·reṯ
verses.literal: Make holy garments for your brother Aaron to give him glory and splendor
verses.literalPt: E farás vestes sagradas a Arão teu irmão, para glória e ornamento.

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֗ה תְּדַבֵּר֙ אֶל־ כָּל־ חַכְמֵי־ לֵ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֥ר מִלֵּאתִ֖יו ר֣וּחַ חָכְמָ֑ה וְעָשׂ֞וּ אֶת־ בִּגְדֵ֧י אַהֲרֹ֛ן לְקַדְּשׁ֖וֹ לְכַהֲנוֹ־ לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh tə·ḏab·bêr ’el- kāl- ḥaḵ·mê- lêḇ ’ă·šer mil·lê·ṯîw rū·aḥ ḥāḵ·māh wə·‘ā·śū ’eṯ- biḡ·ḏê ’a·hă·rōn lə·qad·də·šōw lə·ḵa·hă·nōw- lî
verses.literal: You are to instruct . . . all the skilled craftsmen . . . whom I have filled with a spirit of wisdom to make garments for Aaron’s consecration so that he may serve Me as priest . . .
verses.literalPt: Falarás também a todos os que são sábios de coração, a quem eu tenho enchido do espírito da sabedoria, que façam vestes a Arão para santificá-lo; para que me administre o ofício sacerdotal.

verses.original: וְאֵ֨לֶּה הַבְּגָדִ֜ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר יַעֲשׂ֗וּ חֹ֤שֶׁן וְאֵפוֹד֙ וּמְעִ֔יל וּכְתֹ֥נֶת תַּשְׁבֵּ֖ץ מִצְנֶ֣פֶת וְאַבְנֵ֑ט וְעָשׂ֨וּ בִגְדֵי־ קֹ֜דֶשׁ לְאַהֲרֹ֥ן אָחִ֛יךָ וּלְבָנָ֖יו לְכַהֲנוֹ־ לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh hab·bə·ḡā·ḏîm ’ă·šer ya·‘ă·śū ḥō·šen wə·’ê·p̄ō·wḏ ū·mə·‘îl ū·ḵə·ṯō·neṯ taš·bêṣ miṣ·ne·p̄eṯ wə·’aḇ·nêṭ wə·‘ā·śū ḇiḡ·ḏê- qō·ḏeš lə·’a·hă·rōn ’ā·ḥî·ḵā ū·lə·ḇā·nāw lə·ḵa·hă·nōw- lî
verses.literal: These are the garments that they shall make a breastpiece an ephod a robe a woven tunic a turban and a sash They are to make these holy garments for your brother Aaron and his sons so that they may serve Me as priests
verses.literalPt: Estas pois são as vestes que farão: um peitoral, e um éfode, e um manto, e uma túnica bordada, uma mitra, e um cinto; farão, pois, santas vestes para Arão, teu irmão, e para seus filhos, para me administrarem o ofício sacerdotal.

verses.original: וְהֵם֙ יִקְח֣וּ אֶת־ הַזָּהָ֔ב וְאֶת־ הַתְּכֵ֖לֶת וְאֶת־ הָֽאַרְגָּמָ֑ן וְאֶת־ תּוֹלַ֥עַת הַשָּׁנִ֖י וְאֶת־ הַשֵּֽׁשׁ׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·hêm yiq·ḥū ’eṯ- haz·zā·hāḇ wə·’eṯ- hat·tə·ḵê·leṯ wə·’eṯ- hā·’ar·gā·mān wə·’eṯ- tō·w·la·‘aṯ haš·šā·nî wə·’eṯ- haš·šêš
verses.literal: They shall use gold along with blue purple and scarlet yarn . . . and fine linen
verses.literalPt: E tomarão o ouro, e o azul, e a púrpura, e o carmesim, e o linho fino,

verses.original: וְעָשׂ֖וּ אֶת־ הָאֵפֹ֑ד זָ֠הָב תְּכֵ֨לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֜ן תּוֹלַ֧עַת שָׁנִ֛י וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מָשְׁזָ֖ר מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה חֹשֵֽׁב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śū ’eṯ- hā·’ê·p̄ōḏ zā·hāḇ tə·ḵê·leṯ wə·’ar·gā·mān tō·w·la·‘aṯ šā·nî wə·šêš mā·šə·zār ma·‘ă·śêh ḥō·šêḇ
verses.literal: They are to make the ephod of finely spun linen embroidered . . . with gold and with blue purple and scarlet yarn . . .
verses.literalPt: E farão o éfode de ouro, e de azul, e de púrpura, e de carmesim, e de linho fino torcido, de obra esmerada.

verses.original: שְׁתֵּ֧י כְתֵפֹ֣ת חֹֽבְרֹ֗ת יִֽהְיֶה־ לּ֛וֹ אֶל־ שְׁנֵ֥י קְצוֹתָ֖יו וְחֻבָּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: šə·tê ḵə·ṯê·p̄ōṯ ḥō·ḇə·rōṯ yih·yeh- lōw ’el- šə·nê qə·ṣō·w·ṯāw wə·ḥub·bār
verses.literal: It shall have two shoulder pieces attached at two of its corners so it can be fastened
verses.literalPt: Terá duas ombreiras, que se unam às suas duas pontas, e assim se unirá.

verses.original: וְחֵ֤שֶׁב אֲפֻדָּתוֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָלָ֔יו כְּמַעֲשֵׂ֖הוּ מִמֶּ֣נּוּ יִהְיֶ֑ה זָהָ֗ב תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מָשְׁזָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḥê·šeḇ ’ă·p̄ud·dā·ṯōw ’ă·šer ‘ā·lāw kə·ma·‘ă·śê·hū mim·men·nū yih·yeh zā·hāḇ tə·ḵê·leṯ wə·’ar·gā·mān wə·ṯō·w·la·‘aṯ šā·nî wə·šêš mā·šə·zār
verses.literal: And the skillfully woven waistband of the ephod must be of one piece of the same workmanship with gold with blue purple and scarlet yarn . . . and with finely spun linen
verses.literalPt: E o cinto de obra esmerada do seu éfode, que estará sobre ele, será da sua mesma obra, igualmente, de ouro, de azul, e de púrpura, e de carmesim, e de linho fino torcido.

verses.original: וְלָ֣קַחְתָּ֔ אֶת־ שְׁתֵּ֖י אַבְנֵי־ שֹׁ֑הַם וּפִתַּחְתָּ֣ עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם שְׁמ֖וֹת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·qaḥ·tā ’eṯ- šə·tê ’aḇ·nê- šō·ham ū·p̄it·taḥ·tā ‘ă·lê·hem šə·mō·wṯ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Take two onyx stones and engrave on them the names of the sons of Israel
verses.literalPt: E tomarás duas pedras de ônix, e gravarás nelas os nomes dos filhos de Israel,

verses.original: שִׁשָּׁה֙ מִשְּׁמֹתָ֔ם עַ֖ל הָאֶ֣בֶן הָאֶחָ֑ת וְאֶת־ שְׁמ֞וֹת הַשִּׁשָּׁ֧ה הַנּוֹתָרִ֛ים עַל־ הָאֶ֥בֶן הַשֵּׁנִ֖ית כְּתוֹלְדֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: šiš·šāh miš·šə·mō·ṯām ‘al hā·’e·ḇen hā·’e·ḥāṯ wə·’eṯ- šə·mō·wṯ haš·šiš·šāh han·nō·w·ṯā·rîm ‘al- hā·’e·ḇen haš·šê·nîṯ kə·ṯō·wl·ḏō·ṯām
verses.literal: six of their names on one stone and the remaining six on the other in the order of their birth
verses.literalPt: Seis dos seus nomes numa pedra, e os outros seis nomes na outra pedra, segundo as suas gerações;

verses.original: מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה חָרַשׁ֮ אֶבֶן֒ פִּתּוּחֵ֣י חֹתָ֗ם תְּפַתַּח֙ אֶת־ שְׁתֵּ֣י הָאֲבָנִ֔ים עַל־ שְׁמֹ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מֻסַבֹּ֛ת מִשְׁבְּצ֥וֹת זָהָ֖ב תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ma·‘ă·śêh ḥā·raš ’e·ḇen pit·tū·ḥê ḥō·ṯām tə·p̄at·taḥ ’eṯ- šə·tê hā·’ă·ḇā·nîm ‘al- šə·mōṯ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl mu·sab·bōṯ miš·bə·ṣō·wṯ zā·hāḇ ta·‘ă·śeh ’ō·ṯām
verses.literal: Engrave - the names of the sons of Israel on the two stones the way a gem cutter engraves a seal Then mount the stones in gold filigree settings
verses.literalPt: Conforme à obra do lapidário, como o lavor de selos lavrarás estas duas pedras, com os nomes dos filhos de Israel; engastadas ao redor em ouro as farás.

verses.original: וְשַׂמְתָּ֞ אֶת־ שְׁתֵּ֣י הָאֲבָנִ֗ים עַ֚ל כִּתְפֹ֣ת הָֽאֵפֹ֔ד אַבְנֵ֥י זִכָּרֹ֖ן לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְנָשָׂא֩ אַהֲרֹ֨ן אֶת־ שְׁמוֹתָ֜ם לִפְנֵ֧י יְהוָ֛ה עַל־ שְׁתֵּ֥י כְתֵפָ֖יו לְזִכָּרֹֽן׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·śam·tā ’eṯ- šə·tê hā·’ă·ḇā·nîm ‘al kiṯ·p̄ōṯ hā·’ê·p̄ōḏ ’aḇ·nê zik·kā·rōn liḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·nā·śā ’a·hă·rōn ’eṯ- šə·mō·w·ṯām lip̄·nê Yah·weh ‘al- šə·tê ḵə·ṯê·p̄āw lə·zik·kā·rōn
verses.literal: Fasten both stones on the shoulder pieces of the ephod as memorial stones for the sons of Israel Aaron is to bear their names on his two shoulders as a memorial before the LORD
verses.literalPt: E porás as duas pedras nas ombreiras do éfode, por pedras de memória para os filhos de Israel; e Arão levará os seus nomes sobre ambos os seus ombros, para memória diante do SENHOR.

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ מִשְׁבְּצֹ֖ת זָהָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā miš·bə·ṣōṯ zā·hāḇ
verses.literal: Fashion gold filigree settings
verses.literalPt: Farás também engastes de ouro,

verses.original: וּשְׁתֵּ֤י שַׁרְשְׁרֹת֙ זָהָ֣ב טָה֔וֹר מִגְבָּלֹ֛ת תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתָ֖ם מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה עֲבֹ֑ת וְנָתַתָּ֛ה אֶת־ שַׁרְשְׁרֹ֥ת הָעֲבֹתֹ֖ת עַל־ הַֽמִּשְׁבְּצֹֽת׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·šə·tê šar·šə·rōṯ zā·hāḇ ṭā·hō·wr miḡ·bā·lōṯ ta·‘ă·śeh ’ō·ṯām ma·‘ă·śêh ‘ă·ḇōṯ wə·nā·ṯat·tāh ’eṯ- šar·šə·rōṯ hā·‘ă·ḇō·ṯōṯ ‘al- ham·miš·bə·ṣōṯ
verses.literal: and two chains of pure gold made of braided cord work and attach these chains to the settings
verses.literalPt: E duas cadeiazinhas de ouro puro; de igual medida, de obra de fieira as farás; e as cadeiazinhas de fieira porás nos engastes.

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֜יתָ חֹ֤שֶׁן מִשְׁפָּט֙ מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה חֹשֵׁ֔ב כְּמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה אֵפֹ֖ד תַּעֲשֶׂ֑נּוּ זָ֠הָב תְּכֵ֨לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֜ן וְתוֹלַ֧עַת שָׁנִ֛י וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מָשְׁזָ֖ר תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā ḥō·šen miš·pāṭ ma·‘ă·śêh ḥō·šêḇ kə·ma·‘ă·śêh ’ê·p̄ōḏ ta·‘ă·śen·nū zā·hāḇ tə·ḵê·leṯ wə·’ar·gā·mān wə·ṯō·w·la·‘aṯ šā·nî wə·šêš mā·šə·zār ta·‘ă·śeh ’ō·ṯōw
verses.literal: You are also to make a breastpiece of judgment with the same workmanship . . . . . . as the ephod Construct it with gold with blue purple and scarlet yarn . . . and with finely spun linen
verses.literalPt: Farás também o peitoral do juízo de obra esmerada, conforme à obra do éfode o farás; de ouro, de azul, e de púrpura, e de carmesim, e de linho fino torcido o farás.

verses.original: רָב֥וּעַ יִֽהְיֶ֖ה כָּפ֑וּל זֶ֥רֶת אָרְכּ֖וֹ וְזֶ֥רֶת רָחְבּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: rā·ḇū·a‘ yih·yeh kā·p̄ūl ze·reṯ ’ā·rə·kōw wə·ze·reṯ rā·ḥə·bōw
verses.literal: It must be square when folded over double a span long and a span wide
verses.literalPt: Quadrado e duplo, será de um palmo o seu comprimento, e de um palmo a sua largura.

verses.original: וּמִלֵּאתָ֥ בוֹ֙ מִלֻּ֣אַת אֶ֔בֶן אַרְבָּעָ֖ה טוּרִ֣ים אָ֑בֶן ט֗וּר אֹ֤דֶם פִּטְדָה֙ וּבָרֶ֔קֶת הַטּ֖וּר הָאֶחָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mil·lê·ṯā ḇōw mil·lu·’aṯ ’e·ḇen ’ar·bā·‘āh ṭū·rîm ’ā·ḇen ṭūr ’ō·ḏem piṭ·ḏāh ū·ḇā·re·qeṯ haṭ·ṭūr hā·’e·ḥāḏ
verses.literal: And mount on it a setting of gemstones four rows of stones In the first row there shall be a ruby a topaz and an emerald
verses.literalPt: E o encherás de pedras de engaste, com quatro ordens de pedras; a ordem de um sárdio, de um topázio, e de um carbúnculo; esta será a primeira ordem;

verses.original: וְהַטּ֖וּר הַשֵּׁנִ֑י נֹ֥פֶךְ סַפִּ֖יר וְיָהֲלֹֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·haṭ·ṭūr haš·šê·nî nō·p̄eḵ sap·pîr wə·yā·hă·lōm
verses.literal: in the second row a turquoise a sapphire and a diamond
verses.literalPt: E a segunda ordem será de uma esmeralda, de uma safira, e de um diamante;

verses.original: וְהַטּ֖וּר הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֑י לֶ֥שֶׁם שְׁב֖וֹ וְאַחְלָֽמָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·haṭ·ṭūr haš·šə·lî·šî le·šem šə·ḇōw wə·’aḥ·lā·māh
verses.literal: in the third row a jacinth an agate and an amethyst
verses.literalPt: E a terceira ordem será de um jacinto, de uma ágata, e de uma ametista;

verses.original: וְהַטּוּר֙ הָרְבִיעִ֔י תַּרְשִׁ֥ישׁ וְשֹׁ֖הַם וְיָשְׁפֵ֑ה מְשֻׁבָּצִ֥ים זָהָ֛ב יִהְי֖וּ בְּמִלּוּאֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·haṭ·ṭūr hā·rə·ḇî·‘î tar·šîš wə·šō·ham wə·yā·šə·p̄êh mə·šub·bā·ṣîm zā·hāḇ yih·yū bə·mil·lū·’ō·ṯām
verses.literal: and in the fourth row a beryl an onyx and a jasper . . . Mount these stones in gold filigree settings
verses.literalPt: E a quarta ordem será de um berilo, e de um ônix, e de um jaspe; engastadas em ouro serão nos seus engastes.

verses.original: וְ֠הָאֲבָנִים תִּֽהְיֶ֜יןָ עַל־ שְׁמֹ֧ת בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל שְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה עַל־ שְׁמֹתָ֑ם פִּתּוּחֵ֤י חוֹתָם֙ אִ֣ישׁ עַל־ שְׁמ֔וֹ תִּֽהְיֶ֕יןָ לִשְׁנֵ֥י עָשָׂ֖ר שָֽׁבֶט׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·’ă·ḇā·nîm tih·ye·nā ‘al- šə·mōṯ bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl šə·têm ‘eś·rêh ‘al- šə·mō·ṯām pit·tū·ḥê ḥō·w·ṯām ’îš ‘al- šə·mōw tih·ye·nā liš·nê ‘ā·śār šā·ḇeṭ
verses.literal: The twelve . . . stones are to correspond to the names of the sons of Israel each . . . . . . . . . engraved like a seal with the name of one of the twelve . . . tribes
verses.literalPt: E serão aquelas pedras segundo os nomes dos filhos de Israel, doze segundo os seus nomes; serão esculpidas como selos, cada uma com o seu nome, para as doze tribos.

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֧יתָ עַל־ הַחֹ֛שֶׁן שַֽׁרְשֹׁ֥ת גַּבְלֻ֖ת מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה עֲבֹ֑ת זָהָ֖ב טָהֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā ‘al- ha·ḥō·šen šar·šōṯ gaḇ·luṯ ma·‘ă·śêh ‘ă·ḇōṯ zā·hāḇ ṭā·hō·wr
verses.literal: For the breastpiece . . . make . . . braided chains . . . like cords of pure gold
verses.literalPt: Também farás para o peitoral cadeiazinhas de igual medida, obra trançada de ouro puro.

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֙יתָ֙ עַל־ הַחֹ֔שֶׁן שְׁתֵּ֖י טַבְּע֣וֹת זָהָ֑ב וְנָתַתָּ֗ אֶת־ שְׁתֵּי֙ הַטַּבָּע֔וֹת עַל־ שְׁנֵ֖י קְצ֥וֹת הַחֹֽשֶׁן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā ‘al- ha·ḥō·šen šə·tê ṭab·bə·‘ō·wṯ zā·hāḇ wə·nā·ṯa·tā ’eṯ- šə·tê haṭ·ṭab·bā·‘ō·wṯ ‘al- šə·nê qə·ṣō·wṯ ha·ḥō·šen
verses.literal: You are also to make - two gold rings and fasten them . . . to the two corners of the breastpiece
verses.literalPt: Também farás para o peitoral dois anéis de ouro, e porás os dois anéis nas extremidades do peitoral.

verses.original: וְנָתַתָּ֗ה אֶת־ שְׁתֵּי֙ עֲבֹתֹ֣ת הַזָּהָ֔ב עַל־ שְׁתֵּ֖י הַטַּבָּעֹ֑ת אֶל־ קְצ֖וֹת הַחֹֽשֶׁן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tāh ’eṯ- šə·tê ‘ă·ḇō·ṯōṯ haz·zā·hāḇ ‘al- šə·tê haṭ·ṭab·bā·‘ōṯ ’el- qə·ṣō·wṯ ha·ḥō·šen
verses.literal: Then fasten the two gold chains to the two gold rings at the corners of the breastpiece
verses.literalPt: Então porás as duas cadeiazinhas de fieira de ouro nos dois anéis, nas extremidades do peitoral;

verses.original: וְאֵ֨ת שְׁתֵּ֤י קְצוֹת֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י הָעֲבֹתֹ֔ת תִּתֵּ֖ן עַל־ שְׁתֵּ֣י הַֽמִּשְׁבְּצ֑וֹת וְנָתַתָּ֛ה עַל־ כִּתְפ֥וֹת הָאֵפֹ֖ד אֶל־ מ֥וּל פָּנָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ šə·tê qə·ṣō·wṯ šə·tê hā·‘ă·ḇō·ṯōṯ tit·tên ‘al- šə·tê ham·miš·bə·ṣō·wṯ wə·nā·ṯat·tāh ‘al- kiṯ·p̄ō·wṯ hā·’ê·p̄ōḏ ’el- mūl pā·nāw
verses.literal: and fasten the other ends of the two chains to the two filigree settings attaching them to the shoulder pieces of the ephod at the front . . .
verses.literalPt: E as duas pontas das duas cadeiazinhas de fieira colocarás nos dois engastes, e as porás nas ombreiras do éfode, na frente dele.

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֗יתָ שְׁתֵּי֙ טַבְּע֣וֹת זָהָ֔ב וְשַׂמְתָּ֣ אֹתָ֔ם עַל־ שְׁנֵ֖י קְצ֣וֹת הַחֹ֑שֶׁן עַל־ שְׂפָת֕וֹ אֲשֶׁ֛ר אֶל־ עֵ֥בֶר הָאֵפֹ֖ד בָּֽיְתָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā šə·tê ṭab·bə·‘ō·wṯ zā·hāḇ wə·śam·tā ’ō·ṯām ‘al- šə·nê qə·ṣō·wṯ ha·ḥō·šen ‘al- śə·p̄ā·ṯōw ’ă·šer ’el- ‘ê·ḇer hā·’ê·p̄ōḏ bā·yə·ṯāh
verses.literal: Make two more gold rings and attach them to the other two corners of the breastpiece on . . . the inside edge next to the ephod
verses.literalPt: Farás também dois anéis de ouro, e os porás nas duas extremidades do peitoral, na sua borda que estiver junto ao éfode por dentro.

verses.original: וְעָשִׂיתָ֮ שְׁתֵּ֣י טַבְּע֣וֹת זָהָב֒ וְנָתַתָּ֣ה אֹתָ֡ם עַל־ שְׁתֵּי֩ כִתְפ֨וֹת הָאֵפ֤וֹד מִלְּמַ֙טָּה֙ מִמּ֣וּל פָּנָ֔יו לְעֻמַּ֖ת מֶחְבַּרְתּ֑וֹ מִמַּ֕עַל לְחֵ֖שֶׁב הָאֵפֽוֹד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā šə·tê ṭab·bə·‘ō·wṯ zā·hāḇ wə·nā·ṯat·tāh ’ō·ṯām ‘al- šə·tê ḵiṯ·p̄ō·wṯ hā·’ê·p̄ō·wḏ mil·lə·maṭ·ṭāh mim·mūl pā·nāw lə·‘um·maṯ meḥ·bar·tōw mim·ma·‘al lə·ḥê·šeḇ hā·’ê·p̄ō·wḏ
verses.literal: Make two additional gold rings and attach them to the bottom of the two shoulder pieces of the ephod on its front . . . near its seam just above its woven waistband . . .
verses.literalPt: Farás também dois anéis de ouro, que porás nas duas ombreiras do éfode, abaixo, na frente dele, perto da sua juntura, sobre o cinto de obra esmerada do éfode.

verses.original: וְיִרְכְּס֣וּ אֶת־ הַ֠חֹשֶׁן מִטַּבְּעֹתוֹ אֶל־ טַבְּעֹ֤ת הָאֵפֹד֙ בִּפְתִ֣יל תְּכֵ֔לֶת לִֽהְי֖וֹת עַל־ חֵ֣שֶׁב הָאֵפ֑וֹד וְלֹֽא־ יִזַּ֣ח הַחֹ֔שֶׁן מֵעַ֖ל הָאֵפֽוֹד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yir·kə·sū ’eṯ- ha·ḥō·šen miṭ·ṭab·bə·ʿō·ṯō ’el- ṭab·bə·‘ōṯ hā·’ê·p̄ōḏ bip̄·ṯîl tə·ḵê·leṯ lih·yō·wṯ ‘al- ḥê·šeḇ hā·’ê·p̄ō·wḏ wə·lō- yiz·zaḥ ha·ḥō·šen mê·‘al hā·’ê·p̄ō·wḏ
verses.literal: The rings of the breastpiece shall be tied to the rings of the ephod with a cord of blue yarn so that the breastpiece is above the waistband of the ephod and does not swing out from the ephod
verses.literalPt: E ligarão o peitoral, com os seus anéis, aos anéis do éfode por cima, com um cordão de azul, para que esteja sobre o cinto de obra esmerada do éfode; e nunca se separará o peitoral do éfode.

verses.original: וְנָשָׂ֣א אַ֠הֲרֹן אֶת־ שְׁמ֨וֹת בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל בְּחֹ֧שֶׁן הַמִּשְׁפָּ֛ט עַל־ לִבּ֖וֹ בְּבֹא֣וֹ אֶל־ הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ לְזִכָּרֹ֥ן לִפְנֵֽי־ יְהוָ֖ה תָּמִֽיד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·śā ’a·hă·rōn ’eṯ- šə·mō·wṯ bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl bə·ḥō·šen ham·miš·pāṭ ‘al- lib·bōw bə·ḇō·’ōw ’el- haq·qō·ḏeš lə·zik·kā·rōn lip̄·nê- Yah·weh tā·mîḏ
verses.literal: Whenever Aaron enters . . . the Holy Place he shall bear the names of the sons of Israel over his heart on the breastpiece of judgment as a continual reminder before the LORD
verses.literalPt: Assim Arão levará os nomes dos filhos de Israel no peitoral do juízo sobre o seu coração, quando entrar no santuário, para memória diante do SENHOR continuamente.

verses.original: וְנָתַתָּ֞ אֶל־ חֹ֣שֶׁן הַמִּשְׁפָּ֗ט אֶת־ הָאוּרִים֙ וְאֶת־ הַתֻּמִּ֔ים וְהָיוּ֙ עַל־ לֵ֣ב אַהֲרֹ֔ן בְּבֹא֖וֹ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְנָשָׂ֣א אַ֠הֲרֹן אֶת־ מִשְׁפַּ֨ט בְּנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל עַל־ לִבּ֛וֹ לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה תָּמִֽיד׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯa·tā ’el- ḥō·šen ham·miš·pāṭ ’eṯ- hā·’ū·rîm wə·’eṯ- hat·tum·mîm wə·hā·yū ‘al- lêḇ ’a·hă·rōn bə·ḇō·’ōw lip̄·nê Yah·weh wə·nā·śā ’a·hă·rōn ’eṯ- miš·paṭ bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ‘al- lib·bōw lip̄·nê Yah·weh tā·mîḏ
verses.literal: And place the Urim and Thummim in the breastpiece of judgment so that they will also be over Aaron’s heart whenever he comes before the LORD Aaron will continually carry the judgment of the sons of Israel over his heart before the LORD
verses.literalPt: Também porás no peitoral do juízo Urim e Tumim, para que estejam sobre o coração de Arão, quando entrar diante do SENHOR: assim Arão levará o juízo dos filhos de Israel sobre o seu coração diante do SENHOR continuamente.

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֛יתָ אֶת־ מְעִ֥יל הָאֵפ֖וֹד כְּלִ֥יל תְּכֵֽלֶת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā ’eṯ- mə·‘îl hā·’ê·p̄ō·wḏ kə·lîl tə·ḵê·leṯ
verses.literal: You are to make the robe of the ephod entirely of blue cloth
verses.literalPt: Também farás o manto do éfode, todo de azul.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֥ה פִֽי־ רֹאשׁ֖וֹ בְּתוֹכ֑וֹ שָׂפָ֡ה יִֽהְיֶה֩ לְפִ֨יו סָבִ֜יב מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה אֹרֵ֗ג כְּפִ֥י תַחְרָ֛א יִֽהְיֶה־ לּ֖וֹ לֹ֥א יִקָּרֵֽעַ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh p̄î- rō·šōw bə·ṯō·w·ḵōw śā·p̄āh yih·yeh lə·p̄îw sā·ḇîḇ ma·‘ă·śêh ’ō·rêḡ kə·p̄î ṯaḥ·rā yih·yeh- lōw lō yiq·qā·rê·a‘
verses.literal: with an opening at its top in the center Around the opening shall be a woven . . . collar with an opening like that of a garment so that it will not tear
verses.literalPt: E a abertura da cabeça estará no meio dele; esta abertura terá uma borda de obra tecida ao redor; como abertura de cota de malha será, para que não se rompa.

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֣יתָ עַל־ שׁוּלָ֗יו רִמֹּנֵי֙ תְּכֵ֤לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן֙ וְתוֹלַ֣עַת שָׁנִ֔י עַל־ שׁוּלָ֖יו סָבִ֑יב וּפַעֲמֹנֵ֥י זָהָ֛ב בְּתוֹכָ֖ם סָבִֽיב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā ‘al- šū·lāw rim·mō·nê tə·ḵê·leṯ wə·’ar·gā·mān wə·ṯō·w·la·‘aṯ šā·nî ‘al- šū·lāw sā·ḇîḇ ū·p̄a·‘ă·mō·nê zā·hāḇ bə·ṯō·w·ḵām sā·ḇîḇ
verses.literal: Make pomegranates of blue purple and scarlet yarn . . . . . . . . . all the way around the lower hem with gold bells between them
verses.literalPt: E nas suas bordas farás romãs de azul, e de púrpura, e de carmesim, ao redor das suas bordas; e campainhas de ouro no meio delas ao redor.

verses.original: פַּעֲמֹ֤ן זָהָב֙ וְרִמּ֔וֹן פַּֽעֲמֹ֥ן זָהָ֖ב וְרִמּ֑וֹן עַל־ שׁוּלֵ֥י הַמְּעִ֖יל סָבִֽיב׃
verses.transliteration: pa·‘ă·mōn zā·hāḇ wə·rim·mō·wn pa·‘ă·mōn zā·hāḇ wə·rim·mō·wn ‘al- šū·lê ham·mə·‘îl sā·ḇîḇ
verses.literal: alternating the gold bells and pomegranates . . . . . . . . . . . . around the lower hem of the robe
verses.literalPt: Uma campainha de ouro, e uma romã, outra campainha de ouro, e outra romã, haverá nas bordas do manto ao redor,

verses.original: וְהָיָ֥ה עַֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֖ן לְשָׁרֵ֑ת וְנִשְׁמַ֣ע ק֠וֹלוֹ בְּבֹא֨וֹ אֶל־ הַקֹּ֜דֶשׁ לִפְנֵ֧י יְהוָ֛ה וּבְצֵאת֖וֹ וְלֹ֥א יָמֽוּת׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ‘al- ’a·hă·rōn lə·šā·rêṯ wə·niš·ma‘ qō·w·lōw bə·ḇō·’ōw ’el- haq·qō·ḏeš lip̄·nê Yah·weh ū·ḇə·ṣê·ṯōw wə·lō yā·mūṯ
verses.literal: Aaron must wear the robe whenever he ministers and its sound will be heard when he enters or exits . . . the sanctuary before the LORD so that he will not die
verses.literalPt: E estará sobre Arão quando ministrar, para que se ouça o seu sonido, quando entrar no santuário diante do SENHOR, e quando sair, para que não morra.

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ צִּ֖יץ זָהָ֣ב טָה֑וֹר וּפִתַּחְתָּ֤ עָלָיו֙ פִּתּוּחֵ֣י חֹתָ֔ם קֹ֖דֶשׁ לַֽיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā ṣîṣ zā·hāḇ ṭā·hō·wr ū·p̄it·taḥ·tā ‘ā·lāw pit·tū·ḥê ḥō·ṯām qō·ḏeš Yah·weh
verses.literal: You are to make a plate of pure gold and engrave on it as on a seal HOLY TO THE LORD
verses.literalPt: Também farás uma lâmina de ouro puro, e nela gravarás como as gravuras de selos: SANTIDADE AO SENHOR.

verses.original: וְשַׂמְתָּ֤ אֹתוֹ֙ עַל־ פְּתִ֣יל תְּכֵ֔לֶת וְהָיָ֖ה עַל־ הַמִּצְנָ֑פֶת אֶל־ מ֥וּל פְּנֵֽי־ הַמִּצְנֶ֖פֶת יִהְיֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·śam·tā ’ō·ṯōw ‘al- pə·ṯîl tə·ḵê·leṯ wə·hā·yāh ‘al- ham·miṣ·nā·p̄eṯ ’el- mūl pə·nê- ham·miṣ·ne·p̄eṯ yih·yeh
verses.literal: Fasten to it a blue cord to mount it on the turban it shall be on the front . . . of the turban . . .
verses.literalPt: E atá-la-ás com um cordão de azul, de modo que esteja na mitra, na frente da mitra estará;

verses.original: וְהָיָה֮ עַל־ מֵ֣צַח אַהֲרֹן֒ וְנָשָׂ֨א אַהֲרֹ֜ן אֶת־ עֲוֺ֣ן הַקֳּדָשִׁ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר יַקְדִּ֙ישׁוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְכָֽל־ מַתְּנֹ֖ת קָדְשֵׁיהֶ֑ם וְהָיָ֤ה עַל־ מִצְחוֹ֙ תָּמִ֔יד לְרָצ֥וֹן לָהֶ֖ם לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ‘al- mê·ṣaḥ ’a·hă·rōn wə·nā·śā ’a·hă·rōn ’eṯ- ‘ă·wōn haq·qo·ḏā·šîm ’ă·šer yaq·dî·šū bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl lə·ḵāl mat·tə·nōṯ qā·ḏə·šê·hem wə·hā·yāh ‘al- miṣ·ḥōw tā·mîḏ lə·rā·ṣō·wn lā·hem lip̄·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: And it will be worn on Aaron’s forehead so that he may bear the iniquity of the holy things that the sons of Israel consecrate with regard to all their holy gifts It shall always be on his forehead so that they may be acceptable before the LORD
verses.literalPt: E estará sobre a testa de Arão, para que Arão leve a iniqüidade das coisas santas, que os filhos de Israel santificarem em todas as ofertas de suas coisas santas; e estará continuamente na sua testa, para que tenham aceitação perante o SENHOR.

verses.original: וְשִׁבַּצְתָּ֙ הַכְּתֹ֣נֶת שֵׁ֔שׁ וְעָשִׂ֖יתָ מִצְנֶ֣פֶת שֵׁ֑שׁ וְאַבְנֵ֥ט תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה רֹקֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šib·baṣ·tā hak·kə·ṯō·neṯ šêš wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā miṣ·ne·p̄eṯ šêš wə·’aḇ·nêṭ ta·‘ă·śeh ma·‘ă·śêh rō·qêm
verses.literal: You are to weave the tunic with fine linen make the turban of fine linen and fashion . . . an embroidered sash
verses.literalPt: Também farás túnica de linho fino; também farás uma mitra de linho fino; mas o cinto farás de obra de bordador.

verses.original: וְלִבְנֵ֤י אַהֲרֹן֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה כֻתֳּנֹ֔ת וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ לָהֶ֖ם אַבְנֵטִ֑ים וּמִגְבָּעוֹת֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה לָהֶ֔ם לְכָב֖וֹד וּלְתִפְאָֽרֶת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·liḇ·nê ’a·hă·rōn ta·‘ă·śeh ḵut·to·nōṯ wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā lā·hem ’aḇ·nê·ṭîm ū·miḡ·bā·‘ō·wṯ ta·‘ă·śeh lā·hem lə·ḵā·ḇō·wḏ ū·lə·ṯip̄·’ā·reṯ
verses.literal: Make tunics sashes and headbands . . . for Aaron’s sons to give them glory and splendor
verses.literalPt: Também farás túnicas aos filhos de Arão, e far-lhes-ás cintos; também lhes farás tiaras, para glória e ornamento.

verses.original: וְהִלְבַּשְׁתָּ֤ אֹתָם֙ אֶת־ אַהֲרֹ֣ן אָחִ֔יךָ וְאֶת־ בָּנָ֖יו אִתּ֑וֹ וּמָשַׁחְתָּ֨ אֹתָ֜ם וּמִלֵּאתָ֧ אֶת־ יָדָ֛ם וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖ם וְכִהֲנ֥וּ לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hil·baš·tā ’ō·ṯām ’eṯ- ’a·hă·rōn ’ā·ḥî·ḵā wə·’eṯ- bā·nāw ’it·tōw ū·mā·šaḥ·tā ’ō·ṯām ū·mil·lê·ṯā ’eṯ- yā·ḏām wə·qid·daš·tā ’ō·ṯām wə·ḵi·hă·nū lî
verses.literal: After you put these garments on your brother Aaron and his sons . . . anoint them ordain them . . . and consecrate them so that they may serve Me as priests
verses.literalPt: E vestirás com eles a Arão, teu irmão, e também seus filhos; e os ungirás e consagrarás, e os santificarás, para que me administrem o sacerdócio.

verses.original: וַעֲשֵׂ֤ה לָהֶם֙ מִכְנְסֵי־ בָ֔ד לְכַסּ֖וֹת בְּשַׂ֣ר עֶרְוָ֑ה מִמָּתְנַ֥יִם וְעַד־ יְרֵכַ֖יִם יִהְיֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wa·‘ă·śêh lā·hem miḵ·nə·sê- ḇāḏ lə·ḵas·sō·wṯ bə·śar ‘er·wāh mim·mā·ṯə·na·yim wə·‘aḏ- yə·rê·ḵa·yim yih·yū
verses.literal: Make linen undergarments to cover their bare flesh extending from waist to thigh
verses.literalPt: Faze-lhes também calções de linho, para cobrirem a carne nua; irão dos lombos até as coxas.

verses.original: וְהָיוּ֩ עַל־ אַהֲרֹ֨ן וְעַל־ בָּנָ֜יו בְּבֹאָ֣ם׀ אֶל־ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֗ד א֣וֹ בְגִשְׁתָּ֤ם אֶל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ לְשָׁרֵ֣ת בַּקֹּ֔דֶשׁ וְלֹא־ יִשְׂא֥וּ עָוֺ֖ן וָמֵ֑תוּ חֻקַּ֥ת עוֹלָ֛ם ל֖וֹ וּלְזַרְע֥וֹ אַחֲרָֽיו׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yū ‘al- ’a·hă·rōn wə·‘al- bā·nāw bə·ḇō·’ām ’el- ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ ’ōw ḇə·ḡiš·tām ’el- ham·miz·bê·aḥ lə·šā·rêṯ baq·qō·ḏeš wə·lō- yiś·’ū ‘ā·wōn wā·mê·ṯū ḥuq·qaṯ ‘ō·w·lām lōw ū·lə·zar·‘ōw ’a·ḥă·rāw
verses.literal: Aaron . . . and his sons must wear them . . . whenever they enter . . . the Tent of Meeting or approach . . . the altar to minister in the Holy Place so that they will not incur guilt and die This is to be a permanent statute for Aaron and his descendants
verses.literalPt: E estarão sobre Arão e sobre seus filhos, quando entrarem na tenda da congregação, ou quando chegarem ao altar para ministrar no santuário, para que não levem iniqüidade e morram; isto será estatuto perpétuo para ele e para a sua descendência depois dele.
